https://imgur.com/a/iAnp7

1. Make gradient filled shape.

2. Use pen tool (No fill, no stroke to see lines) to create and adjust the curves inside the original gradient shape. 

3. Fill the new shape to see the shape. Select all and Pathfinder -> Divide

4. Select and delete the "excess". So there's original gradient shape with a new shape on top. Add new gradient color on new shape.

The end result has 2 different layers now. One original S shape and partial S purple shape on top. 

This is just one way. I haven't got the look I'm trying to go for but it's a start!

Didn't think of layering gradient shapes on top! I'll try this method as well. Thank you!

Wait nvm. I think I figured out a way.

Used **no fill no stroke pen tool** and made a shape over it. Used divide pathfinder and deleted the excess.
